coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); every form page looked at at 100 dpi; the filing's HTML read to confirm that no lines were ever printed on the caption-only rows; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: A unit subscription agreement whose form pages lost their printed lines and boxes in the filing: the investor fills an information page and a signature page (individual, joint or entity), then an individual certificate (pages 17-20) or an entity certificate (pages 20-24) with initials, yes/no answers and its own signature; a FINRA member firm signs an acknowledgment if the investor is a registered representative. No company acceptance block is printed (the company accepts by signing counterparts).
